intro: A small brass key has found its way to you in Searing Gorge. A few words are scratched into its head, marking it as a Dark Iron outhouse key that is not to be copied. Where it leads, you cannot yet say.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The small brass key looks simple enough.. The only thing that seems to make it stand out are some words scratched into the head of it:
You have no idea what it means or what it will lead to.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Who is it? Can't ya see I'm busy?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, I'll be! How in tarnation!? You found the key! I knew them blasted Dark Irons were hiding it after they locked me in here! Thank ya so much, friend. You're the greatest! Now, just turn the key and let ol' Locheed outta here!
